DEPENDENCY_NOT_INSTALLED_ERROR.message: The current module '%s' has dependency which is not installed at its %s.
solutions: Config cangjieOptions/strictCheckDependencies in build-profile.json5 to false to remove strict dependency checking.
Value should be one of: 'arm64-v8a', 'x86_64'.

ABI_FILTERS_NOT_SUPPORTED.message: '%s' not supported for Cangjie. At file: %s
solutions: Please add '%s' or '%s' to cangjie/abiFilters.

CANGJIE_TOML_PATH_CONFIG_ERROR.message: The configured cangjie %s in cangjieOptions/path is incorrect. At file: %s
solutions: Configure the correct %s path.

CANGJIE_TOML_PATH_NOT_EXIST.message: The configured cangjie %s in cangjieOptions/path does not exist. At file: %s
solutions: Configure the correct %s path.

LOW_API_VERSION_ERROR.message: The Cangjie project supports api version 12 or later. At file: %s
solutions: Select api version 12 or later.

COMPATIBLE_SDK_VERSION_ERROR.message: The Cangjie project supports compatibleSdkVersion 12 or later. At file: %s
solutions: Change the value of compatibleSdkVersion to 12 or later.

ONLY_CANGJIE_HSP_NOT_SUPPORTED_ERROR.message: The module '%s' is HSP and contains only Cangjie, it is currently not supported, only the ArkTS and Cangjie hybird HSP is supported.
solutions: Please use ArkTS and Cangjie hybird HSP.

COMPATIBLE_SDK_LOWER_THAN_22_VERSION_ERR.message: When using the default Cangjie SDK, the Cangjie project does not support compatibleSdkVersion lower than 22. At file: %s
solutions: Change the value of compatibleSdkVersion to 22 or higher.

COMPATIBLE_SDK_LOWER_THAN_20_VERSION_ERR.message: When using the compatible Cangjie SDK, the Cangjie project does not support compatibleSdkVersion lower than 20. At file: %s
solutions: Change the value of compatibleSdkVersion to 20 or higher.

FILE_NOT_FOUNF_OR_UNEXCUTABLE.message: Not an internal or external command, operable program, or batch file. At file: %s
